niche.habitat: Mid-cloud decks (1–2 bar), dense migratory herds
niche.diet: Filter-feeds on cloud plankton and chemical aerosols
niche.active: Continuous, follows chemical gradients and herd signals

body: Medium-sized, pod-like creatures with bristled maws that crackle with static charge. Their dual-chambered stomachs separate ammonia-rich and hydrogen-rich feeds, while low bladders keep them suspended in the dense haze.

links: Low H₂ density reduces impact capture efficiency

skill.effect: Passively pulls 8 plankton per second, generating 2 food/sec

chains.weakness: Charge fully neutralizes during nearby lightning strikes, forcing a 6-second feeding drought

journal.en: They eat the sky's static breath.
